Finite bit-supplier construction: reschedule PR589 R439's frame506 B[102:128) as two exact positive-integer factors with **9+12=21 rather than 26 ADDs**. Rebuild required literal full-frame cleanup; the complete local bill is **24,305→24,295 ADDs**. No new κ is claimed.

The new evidence is a witness outside Aaron Wang's merged #891 whole-block destination-once class (minimum 24 at 506). Splitting at original gate 114 permits intermediate rows and a second destination write across factors. Discovery exhausts all 25 original cuts103–127; the minimum 21 occurs at114–116. A separate disjoint-donor-subset/backward Bellman implementation confirms the 9/12 minima without importing discovery. This is a restricted-class minimum, not unrestricted circuit optimality.

- Pinned owning checker on all 661 dirty columns, H1–H5, complete frame paths, nine COPY/ERASE pairs and unchanged paid profile/rank mass 5129.
- Independently emitted full records equal the pinned exporter byte for byte; six full-word/invoice mutations reject. Forward positive bound 49347; reverse 1113070→1107058; payload 93 bits below 104.
- Unchanged C++17/Boost native legality and 5/9/11-stage replay on both words, 883/1327/1549 formal columns,96 rejected omitted-bridge controls; full local/stage bills and signed prefixes.
- Four packaging tests (optimized/environment replay, minimal relocation, corrupt-source certificate preservation, factor/word binding), regenerated search/certificate checks, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-frame506-two-factor/search.py --check && python3 -I -B research/r439-frame506-two-factor/verify.py
```
